title.zh: 四鋼琴環繞 - 非和諧不等式

desc.zh: ADE 樂章寫給四台鋼琴：前、後、左、右各一台，觀眾站在中間。四台同時演奏各自的內容，合起來才是一首曲子；站的位置不同，聽到的重點、音量與方位也不同。這裡的桌面就是場地，滑鼠就是你——移動滑鼠，混音跟著改變。
desc.en: An ADE movement written for four pianos — front, back, left and right — with the audience in the middle. All four play their own material at once and only together form the piece; where you stand changes what you hear, how loud and from where. Here the desktop is the hall and the pointer is you: move it and the mix follows.

concept_level_note: ADR-004 self-check 2026-08-30: distance/direction mixing of four synchronized stems, written from scratch (Web Audio: gain + stereo panner + lowpass per stem). Audio = the user's own original ADE stems.
dependencies: none (Web Audio API only); assets/audio/ade1/*.mp3 + assets/audio/ade/*.mp3 (~20 MB, loaded only when the stage starts)
